long_biography.plain_text:
Jeffrey Mahan built C.J. Mahan Construction into a substantial regional contractor, delivering complex bridge, dam and marine works across the eastern United States. Its defining capabilities included large river crossings, cofferdams and other heavy-civil structures, tying engineering decisions to work in navigable waterways. The company's expansion was sustained by specialist personnel, construction methods and equipment.

In 2011, Mahan implemented a planned succession by installing Douglas McCrae and Gary Yancer as managing partners. He shifted from daily management towards board-level strategy, corporate development and acquisitions. Later public contractor records continued to list him among the company's members, indicating that the founder retained an economic relationship even after operational leadership had broadened.
